source.title: Antidepressant use among American adults in a 50-state survey

notes: Partial list extracted from public supplement. Full table available in source PDF. Aggregate public statistics only. No individual data. These are antidepressant (not SSRI-only) rates. Higher in Midwest/Appalachia, lower in CA/FL/HI. Ideal for state-level choropleth/heatmap when joined to PostGIS state polygons.
